message.content:
Bumetanide tablets in measured doses for retail sale are medicaments of heading 3004. Bumetanide is a sulfonamide-type compound (3-(butylamino)-4-phenoxy-5-sulfamoylbenzoic acid). Within 3004.90, the usual residual subheading is 3004.90.92 (other medicaments), but the question is whether a more specific line applies. I recall that CBP rulings for bumetanide tablets placed them in 3004.90.9250 or 3004.90.9290. Statistical suffixes under 3004.90.92 include 10 (for treating heart conditions?), 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70, 90. From memory, 3004.90.92 breaks down as follows: .10 anthelmintics, .20 ... , .30 ..., .40 ..., .50 ..., .60 ..., .70 ..., .90 other. I believe the diuretic suffix would be "3004.90.9235 Other: diuretics"? I can't confirm it, so I'm going with 3004.90.9290.
